steps.title: Deploy PgBouncer via compose overlay or optional k8s snippet (not default Helm chart)
Point DATABASE_URL at pgbouncer:6432; set PGBOUNCER_TRANSACTION_MODE if needed
Verify SHOW POOLS / SHOW STATS via admin console; record pool sizes
Run load harness (Stage 26/28) against pooler; record p95 and error rate
Fill soak-evidence.example.json; attach to ops change log
